== Japanese printed face ==
Full collector photograph visually transcribed and compared with the English printed face. The Japanese applies the forfeit bonus to all Jawas. The English limits it to “All your Jawas.” The Japanese title literally means “Jawa Nap.” Publication ID 1301_51o follows the approved Japanese catalog; this is not a GEMP implementation claim.
